description:
Java Developer (2+ years experience)

We are looking for talented and passionate Java professionals to join our team and help us design and build reliable, high-quality software solutions.

What you will do

As part of an experienced engineering team, you will contribute to software design and development, and you’ll have the opportunity to propose new technologies and approaches to improve our products and solve technical challenges.

What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years of professional experience with Java / Java EE
  • Experience with JDBC, JPA (Hibernate), and relational databases (MS SQL, PostgreSQL or similar)
  • Familiarity with web services (SOAP and/or REST)
  • Familiarity with web application technologies (Tomcat, Servlets, Thymeleaf or similar)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Solid understanding of software design principles and patterns
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset

Nice to have

  • Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Experience with Spring / Spring Boot, Hibernate and AI usage
  • Front-end exposure (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/jQuery)
  • Python experience would be an advantage
  • Knowledge of unit/integration testing frameworks and tools
  • University degree (preferably Computer Science or a related field)

Key responsibilities

  • Participate in analysis and design of software components and features
  • Develop efficient, testable, maintainable, and well-documented code
  • Suggest and evaluate new tools, frameworks, and technologies
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of quality, performance, and usability
  • Collaborate with teammates to deliver robust solutions end-to-end

What we offer

  • Competitive salary package
  • Private medical insurance
  • Performance bonuses and loyalty rewards
  • Interesting, complex projects with real technical challenges
  • Training and career development opportunities
  • A professional, friendly environment with smart, motivated colleagues
  • Centrally located office
